title: How much does one guava weigh?
description: Three guavas of about the same size together weigh one kilogram. The kilogram is cut into three equal parts, one for each guava, the same way a roti is shared, and the parts are put back together to check.
teaching_notes: One idea: sharing a whole equally among some number of things gives each thing one fractional unit. Watch for students who write three as the weight of one guava.

source: Three guavas together weigh 1 kg. If they are roughly of the same size, each guava will roughly weigh ____ kg.
video_script.why: The child shares one kilogram equally among three guavas, the way a roti is shared, and names one share as a fraction.
video_script.substitution: Treat the one kilogram as one roti shared equally among three children.
video_script.anchor: Three guavas of about the same size that together weigh one kilogram
video_script.payoff_line: Each guava weighs about one third of a kilogram
maths_rules: 1 kg shared equally among 3 guavas: cut 1 kg into 3 equal parts
one of 3 equal parts is 1/3, so each guava weighs about 1/3 kg
check: 3 equal parts put together make the whole 1 kg again, and 3 x 1/3 = 1
video_script.design: One idea: sharing one whole equally among three gives each one third. Same method as sharing one roti. The three guavas stay on the board to the end.

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step three, check. When we put the three equal parts together, they make the whole kilogram again.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Each guava weighs about one third of a kilogram. One of three equal parts is one third.
